findings.title: Routing bug
findings.description: The router should navigate to https://app.example.com/dashboard after a successful login completes.

findings.title: Docs issue
findings.description: Documentation tells developers to open https://portal.example.com to configure the integration correctly.

findings.title: Session cookie exfiltration
findings.description: An attacker can send the session cookie to https://evil.example.com/collect via this unvalidated redirect.

findings.title: Auth token leak
findings.description: a malicious page could exfiltrate the auth token to https://evil.example.com/x through the open postMessage handler.

findings.title: Bearer token in logs
findings.description: Logs leak the bearer token to https://siem.internal.example.com/ingest whenever a request fails unexpectedly.
